verdict.rationale: Drata documents a public REST API v2 with OAuth authentication and broad CRUD coverage (controls, evidence, monitoring tests, custom connections, policies), so compliance workflows can be scripted and driven from automation without the UI. There is no evidence of a CLI, a CI integration such as a GitHub Action, or a guide for running it in pipelines, so headless use depends on custom API scripting. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration, CI/headless usage documentation, guidance on non-interactive service credentials, and independent hands-on corroboration of pipeline use.
